manifest.authority: Each real subagent owns one player profile and must preserve that profile across both chapters. Code owns combat, cognition, emotion, loot, knowledge, impressions, roster prediction and A.

mechanical.method: Every 4-character combination is tested in canonical and reversed formation. Bare and deterministic best-visible-equipment states are reported separately.

diagnostics.mythicRuleValidation: All 19 generated rule classes contain exact mythic=0.01; the deterministic 100,000-item validator observed 988 mythics (0.988%).
diagnostics.mythicRateSampleCaveat: The live-agent unique-drop sample is too small to estimate a 1% rate; its observed percentage is descriptive only.
diagnostics.pairedBetaCaveat: open_novice/paired-beta had no opening mythic but received a mythic level-26 item at Chapter 2 cycle 16 (+160 active power), so only its pre-drop segment is a non-jackpot comparison.
diagnostics.pairedSeedCorrelationRule: The same seed/node/attempt drop is one random observation even when several profiles experience it; profile-level mythic counts are player exposures, not independent probability samples.
diagnostics.retrySeedConfound: Combat attempt number changes the random seed. A loss can become a win without a roster or equipment intervention, weakening causal learning about the wall.
diagnostics.rawDiagnosisBoundaryLimitation: Threat knowledge currently spreads raw gameEvent.diagnosis fields into later player requests. Disposable enemy names and internal role strings can bypass concept interpretation.
diagnostics.cognitionAuditLimitation: The archived trace does not expose a complete P/Q/R/kP plus Agency-to-action audit, and code-owned profile priors remain unverified_prior after contradictory evidence.
diagnostics.emotionSaturationRisk: Several long runs approach the upper emotion range despite major repeated losses, which compresses later positive and negative feedback.
diagnostics.rosterPredictionNaturalProgressRisk: A swap prediction is scoped to the currently selected encounter. If the player swaps after a clear and advances to the newly unlocked encounter, the prediction is invalidated as different_encounter and produces no A feedback.
diagnostics.modelSelectionLimitation: 5.5fast requested; current subagent interface exposes no model selector or actual model identity.
diagnostics.mythicCognitionLimitation: Current probability family combines every non-common drop by node; it does not learn a cross-node 1% mythic belief or dry streak.
diagnostics.mechanicalCoverage: The exhaustive formation scan now covers selected middle gates, r1_main_10, r1_boss, and r2_boss in bare and deterministic best-visible-equipment states.
